sources_audited.title: Infosys Annual Report on Form 20-F for Fiscal 2026
sections_verified: Item 5 (Operating and Financial Review and Prospects)
Item 18 (Consolidated Financial Statements - IFRS 15 Revenue Notes)

dispositions.rationale: Review of the FY26 Integrated Annual Report and Form 20-F finds client-tier counts, top-client concentration and Large Deal TCV (USD 14.9 billion, 55% net new), but no 12-month same-cohort customer revenue-retention or expansion/contraction/churn bridge.

Review of the FY26 IFRS/Ind AS revenue-disaggregation notes finds revenue segmented by offering, vertical, geography and billing type (fixed-price versus T&M), but no issuer-defined recurring-revenue classification or numerator.
